report.summary: The change adds the whole Worker app (DOs, egress, GitHub App, auth, server functions) but cannot pass the repository gates in CLAUDE.md rules 14 and 15. (1) There are no tests: apps/tempo has `"test": "vitest run"` but no test files, no test/ directory and no vitest config, so `bun run test` fails because vitest exits 1 when it finds no test files. Rule 14 also needs a test for every server function, op step and tempod request. (2) src/router.tsx imports `./routeTree.gen`, which is not committed (it is not gitignored and there is no src/routes directory), so `tsc -p tsconfig.json` (`bun run typecheck`) fails to resolve the module. The platform contracts I checked (Container start, intercepts, snapshotContainer and exec against worker-runtime.d.ts), the secret handling, egress credential injection and the owner checks look right. I could not run typecheck, lint or test because node_modules is not installed in the worktree.

findings.text: No tests ship with the new app. CLAUDE.md rule 14 needs a test for every server function, op step and tempod request (DO tests on @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers), and rule 15 needs `bun run test` to pass. With no test files, `vitest run` exits with code 1 ('No test files found'), so the turbo `test` task fails.

evidence.why: find apps/tempo -name '*.test.*' returns nothing, apps/tempo/test does not exist, and there is no vitest.config.*. vitest 4.1.11 without passWithNoTests exits non-zero, so `bun run test` fails. Op runner retries and idempotency, egress rules, crypto, owner checks and tempod event dedup are all untested.

findings.text: The router imports a generated route tree that is not in the commit, and there is no src/routes directory to generate it from. `bun run typecheck` (tsc -p tsconfig.json, which includes src) fails with TS2307.

evidence.why: ls apps/tempo/src shows no routeTree.gen.ts and no routes/ directory. .gitignore lists only `apps/tempo/src/routeTree.gen.ts.bak`, so the file was meant to be committed. tsc does not run the TanStack router generator, so the import does not resolve and CLAUDE.md rule 15 fails.

findings.text: The D1 migrations directory is not committed. Spec 02 says D1 migrations run at deploy with drizzle-kit, and 05 says deploy must apply them. With no SQL files in src/db/migrations, a deploy would create none of the projects, workspaces, github_installations or auth tables. Running `bun run db:generate` and committing the output would fix it.

evidence.why: ls apps/tempo/src/db shows no migrations directory.

findings.text: The backpressure guard reads bufferedAmount through a type cast. The generated WebSocket type in worker-runtime.d.ts does not declare it, so the 4 MiB tooMuchBuffered close may never fire (it falls back to 0). Not blocking; a workerd runtime check would confirm it.

evidence.quote: const buffered = (ws as unknown as { bufferedAmount?: number }).bufferedAmount ?? 0;
evidence.why: The cast exists because the real contract does not expose the property.

findings.text: Events with seq <= tempod_acked_seq are dropped before the incarnation is checked. If a restarted tempod (new incarnation, seq restarting at 1) sends ordinary events before incarnation.changed, they are silently lost. Not blocking; the tempod outbox ordering in spec 02 would confirm whether incarnation.changed always comes first.

checked.risk: Real contracts: Cloudflare Container API, Sandbox SDK 1.0, DO bindings
Failure paths: op runner retries, skips and permanent failures; tempod request timeouts; GitHub retry policy
Idempotency and state: step re-entry, state transitions, event dedup and ack
Security: owner check, ownership checks on workspace functions and channels, secrets in container env, logs and events, egress credential injection
Build and runtime environment: package scripts, tsconfig, turbo tasks, generated files, migrations
Spec conformance: D1 migrations at deploy, Claude token in adapter env, test and gate rules
